about: Tattoo designs Forge can add to a derived look, only on skin the finished outfit leaves visible (docs/BODY_ART_PLAN.md). Every design is vector paths authored in this repository (designs/*.json), rasterised by wardrobe/body_art/raster.py; licence Apache-2.0, like the repository.

designs.name: Tribal Wings
designs.description: Symmetrical winged tribal across the shoulder blades, narrowing to the spine.

designs.name: Thorn Filigree
designs.description: A central diamond with thorned curls to each shoulder blade.

designs.name: Flame
designs.description: A single tribal flame on one shoulder blade.

designs.name: Spine Vine
designs.description: A stem with alternating leaves along the spine.

designs.name: Lotus Ornament
designs.description: A lotus at the centre of the lower back with flourishes to the sides.

designs.name: Crescent and Star
designs.description: A small crescent moon and star at the nape of the neck.
